description: A chromatic quantiser with a switch for each of the twelve semitones, and twelve reference pitch outputs a semitone apart

params.text: Moves the root of the quantiser and of the twelve reference outputs by whole semitones, six down to six up across its travel, with seven reached only at the very ends
Allows that semitone through while it is on, and lights while it is on

inputs.text: The pitch rounded to the nearest semitone
Moves the root by a twelfth of a semitone for every volt, which is far less than the Root lettering beside it implies

outputs.text: The input rounded to the nearest semitone and moved by the root, written only while the button for the incoming semitone is on
A steady pitch a fixed number of semitones above the root, counted from the top starting at the root itself

notes: a semitone whose button is off is not moved to the nearest allowed note: the output is left unwritten that sample and holds whatever pitch it last carried
all twelve semitone buttons come up on, so the quantiser passes every semitone until buttons are switched off
